scope: fixed-proposal replay: TOTAL = E1 + fixed E2 + R0 HIGH (HIGH fixed); not an end-to-end ECRO validation

contrast_notes.E1: O0 at its dev-selected start for this material vs the O0 start-mean (same replays; no scene-based selection)
contrast_notes.contrasts_descriptive_E1: descriptive companion: the dev-selected O0 start vs the mean of the other 7 O0 starts (same replays)
contrast_notes.A_hist / P_hist: descriptive, paired with O0 starts of equal key

label_rule: relative change of start-mean objects stable RMS vs O0 (paired starts), jackknife t(11) 95 %: IMPROVED hi < 0, REGRESSED lo > +0.02, otherwise NEUTRAL
